page.layout: One printed page, title page. Centred title block from top to bottom, with a printer's ornament rule and imprint below. Page number handwritten at top right (not transcribed).

main_text.head: QUÆSTIO THEOLOGICO HISTORICA, AN COETUS ILLE, QUI HODIE, SUB Episcopo Romano, tanquam Universali, eorundem sacrorum communione continetur, Ecclesia sanæ nomen meretur?
main_text.p: Quam, Orthodoxè tractatam, DEO benignè juvante, Publicæ ac placidæ οὐζητήσει subjicit
JOH. RODOLPHUS STUCKIUS, S. Theologiæ Professor:
Respondente JOHANNE JACOBO ABERLINO, Verbi DEI Ministro:
Assumente JOHANNE CASPARO STOLLIO, S. Literarum studioso:
Postridie Synodi Vernæ, Anno M DC LII.

page.notes: The Greek word after "placidæ" is printed in italic Greek letters and is transcribed here as printed as closely as the scan allows: "οὐζητήσει" (uncertain, the word appears to be ζητήσει, the Greek for "examination"). The title block uses long-s style letters that are rendered as plain s. Decorative rule between the names and the imprint is not text.
